svg.title: The Mark of Codex Catalogue
svg.desc: An intricate crimson arcane seal with two rings, a rune inscription along the top, the title along the bottom, an interlocked hexagram filled with sigils and runes, and a central all-seeing eye.

text.font-family: 'Noto Sans Runic','Segoe UI Historic','Segoe UI Symbol','Junicode',serif
text.style: fill:rgb(239, 68, 68);stroke:none;color:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Noto Sans Runic", "Segoe UI Historic", "Segoe UI Symbol", Junicode, serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:auto
